title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch Solid Brass Wire, Oval Combination | Brushed Bronze | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade shower organization with a wall mount basket that keeps soap and bottles within reach in Brushed Bronze, features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms. This oval combination shower basket is crafted from solid brass with ventilated, rust-proof solid brass wires to support drainage—an easy fit for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Brushed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Wall mount installation helps save space in the shower
- Concealed screw mounting hardware
- Wide variety of designer finish options available, including statement colors
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Product type: Shower basket / shower caddy basket
- Style: Traditional; complements heritage bathroom fixtures
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 18.75-Inch L x 4.13-Inch W x 2.25-Inch H; projection 4.13-Inch
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Included items: Basket and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
